models_evaluated: TDM-AID (hybrid deterministic PK engine + GPT-4o + RAG)

links.outcome: Accuracy of pharmacokinetic calculations and dose safety violations in AI vancomycin dosing recommendations
links.effect: Foundational pharmacokinetic calculations were 100% accurate (deterministic engine), but safety violations occurred in 17% of cases, including dose recommendations exceeding 4 g/day.
